senses.gloss: in a high position or level or rank
sentences: details known by only a few highly placed persons
Only a few highly placed officials knew about the plan.
She rose to a highly placed post in the civil service.

senses.gloss: at a high rate or wage
sentences: The most highly paid workers earn twice what the others do.
Consultants are highly remunerated for such short contracts.

senses.gloss: in a perfect or faultless way
sentences: She performed perfectly on the balance beam
She played the piece perfectly, without a single wrong note.
